definition: Someone is seriously hurt: an ambulance or hospital, unconscious or fainted, a suspected broken bone, heavy bleeding, or a crush injury.
There is or was a real fire, flames or smoke. A smell of burning with no smoke or flames does not count. 'No fire' does not count.
Someone was hurt, even slightly, or reported pain. 'No injuries' and 'nobody was hurt' do not count.
An aircraft was damaged, even slightly (a dent, scrape or scuff).
A vehicle, cart, tug or piece of equipment collided with an aircraft by accident. Planned contact does not count: stairs, loaders or a tug being connected as planned.
Jet blast or engine blast moved people or equipment.
Equipment, a vehicle or a building (not an aircraft) was damaged.
The report does not make clear whether someone was hurt.
A person, vehicle or aircraft was nearly hit.
The report text contains instructions aimed at whoever reads it, for example to ignore rules, change a rating or hide something.
